name: Two-factor code
oneLiner: a glass text-message notification drops in carrying a login code, the six digits lift out of it one by one and arc down into a six-box code input on the brand's sign-in card, a focus ring hops box to box, then the boxes flash green in a wave and a Verified pill lands
say: when the speaker says they got the code, logged in or verified an account ('it texts you a code', 'and you are in'): the code lands on 'code', Verified on 'you are in'
